RAP-001.check: Google OAuth (amr oauth): first protected request records one session.observed for the verified subject and one alert decision

RAP-002.check: email OTP (amr otp): first protected request records one session.observed for the verified subject and one alert decision

RAP-003.check: passkey (amr webauthn): first protected request records one session.observed for the verified subject and one alert decision

RAP-004.check: POST /api/auth/verify (bootstrap) before GET /api/me: exactly one observation and one alert

RAP-005.check: GET /api/me then POST bootstrap: a single first-observed event across both routes

RAP-007.check: a workspace API as the very first request: the verifier observes it, and its session checks run before any data

RAP-008.check: GET /api/me ten times (cold process each time): one first-sighting event, one mail

RAP-009.check: parallel first requests (verifier, /api/me, sessions list, workspace) on one new session: one event, no deadlock

RAP-010.check: a refreshed JWT (new iat, same session_id) records no new sign-in

RAP-011.check: a verified JWT without a session_id claim: 401 on every session route, zero rows, no substitute session

RAP-012.check: a forged userId/sessionId in a request body is ignored: the row belongs to the verified subject only

RAP-015.check: no token, an expired token and a token getUser refuses: every security endpoint answers 401, no data

RAP-049.check: DELETE /api/auth/sessions/{own other}: that session is denied, the current one keeps working

RAP-050.check: DELETE of another person's session id: the same 404 as an unknown id, and B's session unchanged

RAP-051.check: repeating DELETE on an already revoked session: same safe response, no second audit row
RAP-051.detail: AssertionError: 2 session.revoked rows for one session
RAP-051.knownGap: a repeated DELETE of an already revoked session writes another session.revoked audit row

RAP-052.check: a revoked session's still-valid access JWT: 401 on the next hosted API request, no data

RAP-053.check: the same revoked JWT straight through the Data API (authenticated role + JWT claims): reads no workspace row

RAP-054.check: the revoked JWT cannot list private Storage objects (the signing step reads storage.objects under the same guard)

RAP-055.check: POST revoke-others: every other session denied, the current one valid, the count exact

RAP-058.check: revoking the current session through the API takes effect at once (the UI offers no revoke button for it)

RAP-059.check: revocation fence in both orders: a write after the revocation commits nothing; a write before it stands alone

RAP-060.check: one revocation applies to the person in every workspace they belong to

RAP-062.check: account protection flag off: a revoked session stays denied (core revocation does not depend on RAPv2)

RAP-063.check: alert preference off: the sign-in is in the account history, and no routine mail

RAP-065.check: alert preference on: the sign-in is in the account history, and exactly one routine mail

RAP-066.check: alert preference off: the sign-in is in the account history, and no routine mail

RAP-067.check: one eligible sign-in with Notification V2 on: the legacy mailer stands down and V2 sends exactly one email; with V2 off the legacy mailer sends exactly one

RAP-068.check: transport failure: the event and audit stay, retries are bounded with backoff, then the delivery is dead (not dropped)

RAP-069.check: provider accepted is `sent`, never `delivered`, until the provider's delivered webhook arrives

RAP-070.check: the same provider callback twice (and concurrently): applied once, no second email

RAP-071.check: two delivery workers ticking at once: one lease, one send, one idempotency key

RAP-078.check: a bounce receipt: the delivery is failed and email suppressed (visible to operations), never delivered

RAP-079.check: anon: no SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE on any session-security table (P0 tables; the P1 tables do not exist yet)

RAP-080.check: authenticated: no direct write on any session-security table, and no read of other people's or person-level rows

RAP-081.check: the service role performs the expected session writes and reads

RAP-082.check: every session-security table has RLS enabled and FORCED (a table with no policy is deny-all to non-bypass roles)

RAP-086.check: user A cannot read or command workspace B through the hosted API (membership check)

RAP-087.check: sign-in events are append-only: no role (authenticated, service_role) may UPDATE or DELETE pr_audit_events

RAP-088.check: account deletion removes the person's session inventory and sign-in history per policy
RAP-088.knownGap: account deletion leaves pr_sessions rows (browser label, first/last seen) and person-level session.* audit events

RAP-089.check: two concurrent first-sighting inserts of one session: exactly one first observation

RAP-091.check: the user id written for a session or revocation is always the verified token subject

RAP-105.check: GETs of the Security Center's data (me, sessions, security events) never revoke, hold or change factors

RAP-133.check: 200 sign-ins in a burst with alerts on: notices are bounded, every event is retained
RAP-133.detail: AssertionError: 200 new-sign-in emails for one burst
RAP-133.knownGap: 200 first sightings with alerts on send 200 new-sign-in emails; no per-person cap on the legacy path

RAP-139.check: flag absent (default off): legacy behaviour — sessions recorded as before, no session.observed, no new friction

RAP-140.check: observe mode: sign-ins are recorded and an ordinary read is not challenged; existing guards unchanged (AAL1 still refused under 2FA)

RAP-142.check: the experimental v2 flag turned off after the revocation: a revoked session stays denied (core revocation does not depend on RAPv2)

RAP-143.check: notification provider outage: the sign-in request does not wait on mail transport and the event is durable
RAP-143.detail: AssertionError: the legacy mailer ran inside the request
RAP-143.knownGap: the legacy new-sign-in mail is sent synchronously inside the request after commit

RAP-146.check: one eligible sign-in with Notification V2 on: the legacy mailer stands down and V2 sends exactly one email; with V2 off the legacy mailer sends exactly one

RAP-147.check: the harness refuses any target but the dedicated local disposable cluster

RAP-150.check: rollback (observe → off): revoked sessions stay revoked and recorded sign-ins stay in the history
